Title: General availability: Full-Text Search for Azure SQL Database

Body.Content:
For applications that manage and store character-based data in Azure SQL Database, Full-Text Search integrates fast, rich search functionality into the database platform. In addition to preview capabilities, support for .xml doc types and the self-service diagnostic experience are enhanced through XEvents. This enables you to easily troubleshoot and identify issues such as indexing errors or unsupported doc types. Full-Text Search is available in all service tiers in Azure SQL Database through T-SQL syntax and Microsoft SQL Server tools. For more information, please visit:
  • Full-Text Search documentation page
  • Full-Text Search is now available in Azure SQL Database
